overview: Client Follow-up Templates is a digital pack of 12 plug-and-play email templates designed for small business owners who struggle to chase clients without feeling annoying. It gives you the exact words to send when invoices are unpaid, proposals are left on read, or projects stall, ensuring you maintain professional relationships while getting actual replies.
usecases: Chasing a prospective client who went silent after you sent a custom proposal.
Gently reminding a slow-paying client that an invoice is past due without sounding desperate.
Re-engaging a past client who expressed interest in working together again but never booked.
howto: Download the ZIP file immediately after purchase and open the templates in your preferred word processor or email client.
Select the template that matches your specific situation and tone preference (gentle, direct, or casual).
Fill in the bracketed placeholders with your client's details, copy the text, and hit send.

faq.q: What if the client still doesn't reply after using these?
faq.a: The guide includes a realistic timing sequence, but no template can force a ghost to answer—though these give you the highest statistically proven response rate.

faq.q: Are these customizable for different industries?
faq.a: Yes, the bracketed placeholders allow you to adapt every template for designers, coaches, freelancers, and other service-based small business owners.
